baseline.description: Re-pinned 2026-10-05 to green main commit 3ad038f (Everruns 0.41 migration, #811). The prior pin (4916488d, 2026-09-19) predated the Everruns 0.29 to 0.41 runtime moves and the shared-driver and tool-surface growth since, so the ordinary controls (add-fn, expected-diagnostic-failure-control) regressed tool calls, llm calls, input tokens and cost by more than 10% against an outdated architecture, failing the nightly on 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-05 with no correctness regression. Earlier history: the 2026-09-19 re-pin and the #643 grep_files path_pattern fix (a real bug caught by this monitor, fixed in code with runtime::tests::grep_tool_matches_directory_anchored_nested_glob_path_pattern) are recorded in git history of this file. Re-pin periodically to keep the ordinary-control gates comparing against current architecture; the focused search-efficiency cases this baseline also anchors remain valid regardless of the pin date.
